raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 28 txn_ids with two versions: record_version 1 and a corrected record_version 2 with a different amount. silver_transactions keeps every raw row with status POSTED, so the 27 keys whose copies are both POSTED come through twice. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id before the status filter removes the duplicates and keeps the latest correction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
